caption_en: Don't say hasbara in English. Public diplomacy, explaining Israel, advocacy.
caption_he:
אל תגידו hasbara באנגלית. תגידו אחת משלוש אלה 👇

דנה בשיחת זום עם לונדון. שואלים אותה מה היא עושה ברשת. היא עונה: I do hasbara!
שקט. בשבילם זו סתם מילה זרה.

הסברה = explaining. אז באנגלית בוחרים מילה לפי החדר:
בפגישה: Public diplomacy
עם חברים: Explaining Israel
בפאנל: Advocacy

לישראל אפילו היה משרד בשם Ministry of Public Diplomacy (משרד ההסברה והתפוצות, מ 2009).

טייק 2: Public diplomacy. I tell Israel's story in English.
אותו סיפור. מילה אחת השתנתה, ולונדון התקרבה למסך.

שמרו את זה לשיחה הבאה.

מקור: Wikipedia, Ministry of Public Diplomacy and Diaspora Affairs; Public diplomacy of Israel (2026).

lines.line: Don't say hasbara in English. Say one of these three.
Dana joins a call with London. They ask what she does online. She says: I do hasbara!
Silence. To them, it's just a foreign word.
Hasbara literally means explaining. So in English, pick the word for the room.
Israel even had a Ministry of Public Diplomacy, from two thousand nine.
Take two. So, what do you do online?
Public diplomacy. I tell Israel's story in English.
Same story. One word changed, and London leaned in.
Save this for your next call.

transcript.heard: Don't say Hasbro in English. Say one of these three. Dana joins a call with London. They ask what she does online. She says, I do Hasbro. Silence. To them, it's just a foreign word. Hasbro literally means explaining. So in English, pick the word for the room. In a meeting, public diplomacy. With friends explaining Israel. On a panel, advocacy. Israel even had the Ministry of Public Diplomacy in 2009. Take two. So what do you do online? Public diplomacy. I tell Israel's story in English. Fascinating. Tell me more. Same story. One word changed, and London leaned in. Save this for your next call. And remember, don't say Hasbro.
